bio: Upscale furniture fashioned out of salvaged wood, comfortable designer chairs upholstered in lovely check fabrics, edelweiss-shaped lighting fixtures set into the ceiling, and pared-down, elegant tableware – this restaurant has a fresh and modern decor. But it isn't just the chic Alpine look that guests go in for. The dishes conjured up by chef Peter A Strauss are equally inspiring. You will be treated to pleasingly stripped-down classic cuisine that takes inspiration in modern, creative trends. The ingredients are always first-rate and predominantly locally sourced. Only a seasonal surprise menu is served here – no à la carte. The striking glass-fronted wine cooler houses an impressive selection of bottles....
